title: Japanese variety starter pack
note: saved_as is the site's own download name; bytes break ties when two share one (ドーン).
source: 効果音ラボ soundeffect-lab.info · free, monetized YouTube OK, no credit needed · don't share the files or register them in Content ID

sounds.label: チーン1
sounds.name: チーン chiin
sounds.description: Buddhist bell 'chiin': something just died. A joke falls flat, a plan fails, she loses, or an awkward silence. Place right after the failure, in the quiet.

sounds.label: ずっこける
sounds.name: ずっこける zukko
sounds.description: Comedic pratfall 'zukoo': someone says something so absurd or dumb that everyone falls over. Right after the absurd line.

sounds.label: ショック1
sounds.name: ガーン shock
sounds.description: Shock sting 'gaan': she realizes something bad, gets betrayed, or hears terrible news. On the moment of realization.

sounds.label: ショック2
sounds.name: ガーン shock 2
sounds.description: A second shock sting, for variety when there is more than one shock in a clip.

sounds.label: 絶望
sounds.name: 絶望 despair
sounds.description: Despair sting: total defeat or hopelessness (game over, lost save, losing everything). Stronger than a shock.

sounds.label: 間抜け1
sounds.name: 間抜け goofy
sounds.description: Goofy deflating sound: a silly mistake, a dumb moment, a derp. Light and funny, not mean.

sounds.label: 間抜け3
sounds.name: 間抜け goofy 2
sounds.description: A second goofy sound, for variety when there are several silly moments.

sounds.label: 目が点になる
sounds.name: 目が点 stunned
sounds.description: Blank 'dot eyes' stare: speechless or confused, 'what did she just say?'. Right after the line that stuns.

sounds.label: ひらめく1
sounds.name: ひらめく idea
sounds.description: Idea 'pikon!': she gets an idea, figures something out, a lightbulb moment.

sounds.label: 驚く
sounds.name: 驚く surprise
sounds.description: Surprise sting: a sudden startle (jumpscare reaction, unexpected event, 'eh?!').

sounds.label: ちゃんちゃん♪1
sounds.name: ちゃんちゃん chan-chan
sounds.description: 'Chan-chan♪' closing jingle: the end of a bit or punchline, the comedic 'and that's that'. At the very end of a segment or the clip.

sounds.label: ドーン（重い演出）
sounds.name: ドーン heavy impact
sounds.description: Heavy dramatic 'DOON' (the Japanese vine boom): a shocking or absurd statement, a dramatic reveal, a bold declaration. Right after the line.

sounds.label: ドーン
sounds.name: ドーン reveal
sounds.description: Lighter 'doon': presenting something, a title, or a confident claim.

sounds.label: ジャジャーン
sounds.name: ジャジャーン ta-da
sounds.description: 'Jajaan' ta-da: showing off a result, a proud reveal, 'look what I made'.

sounds.label: ビシッとツッコミ1
sounds.name: ツッコミ tsukkomi
sounds.description: Tsukkomi slap 'bishi!': someone corrects or calls out a silly statement, like the straight man in manzai. On the correction.

sounds.label: ピコッハンマー
sounds.name: ピコピコハンマー bonk
sounds.description: Toy hammer bonk: playful punishment, when someone says something dumb or teases (the Japanese bonk).

sounds.label: クイズ正解1
sounds.name: ピンポーン correct
sounds.description: Quiz 'correct' chime: she gets something right, a correct guess, 'that's right!'.

sounds.label: クイズ不正解1
sounds.name: ブッブー wrong
sounds.description: Quiz 'wrong' buzzer: a wrong answer, a bad guess, or catching an obvious lie.

sounds.label: ドラムロール
sounds.name: ドラムロール drum roll
sounds.description: Drum roll build-up (several seconds): before a reveal, a result or a big attempt. Start it so it ends where the reveal happens; pair it with the cymbal.

sounds.label: ロールの閉めシンバル
sounds.name: シンバル cymbal finish
sounds.description: Cymbal crash that ends a drum roll: the reveal moment itself.

sounds.label: ゴゴゴゴ
sounds.name: ゴゴゴゴ menacing
sounds.description: Menacing rumble 'gogogo' (JoJo style): she gets angry, serious or intimidating, a threatening aura.

sounds.label: 心臓の鼓動1
sounds.name: 心臓の鼓動 heartbeat
sounds.description: Heartbeat: tension, nervousness, a scary moment, or a doki-doki romantic moment.

sounds.saved_as: 寒いギャグで突風が吹く
sounds.label: 寒いギャグで突風
sounds.name: 寒い突風 cold wind
sounds.description: Cold gust after a dead joke: an unfunny pun (oyaji gag), an awkward 'samui' moment.

sounds.label: 和太鼓ドン
sounds.name: 和太鼓 taiko don
sounds.description: Taiko drum 'DON': an emphatic statement, a title, a dramatic announcement with Japanese flavour.

sounds.label: 自主規制ピー音
sounds.name: ピー音 bleep
sounds.description: Censor bleep: covers a swear word or something she shouldn't say (a real name, a spoiler). Place exactly over the word and duck her voice fully (-20 dB).

sounds.label: 可愛く輝く1
sounds.name: 可愛く輝く cute sparkle
sounds.description: Cute sparkle: an idol pose, a kawaii moment, a cute line or a wink.

sounds.label: キラッ1
sounds.name: キラッ sparkle
sounds.description: Quick sparkle 'kira!': a smug face, a cool line, a little flourish.

sounds.label: ヒューン
sounds.name: ヒューン whoosh
sounds.description: Whoosh 'hyuun': something flies off, someone falls, or a fast transition.

sounds.label: シーン切り替え1
sounds.name: シーン切り替え transition
sounds.description: Scene transition swoosh: a jump cut to a new topic or a time skip.

sounds.label: 落ち込む
sounds.name: 落ち込む dejected
sounds.description: Dejected sting: she gets sad, disappointed or deflated.

sounds.label: しょげる
sounds.name: しょげる cute sulk
sounds.description: Cute sulking sound: she pouts or sulks, or gets teased into a cute sad face.

sounds.label: アヒルが大笑い
sounds.name: アヒル大笑い mocking laugh
sounds.description: Silly mocking laugh: laughing at a failure or a ridiculous moment (playful, not cruel).

sounds.saved_as: へたくそトランペット
sounds.label: へたくそトランペット
sounds.name: へたくそトランペット sad trumpet
sounds.description: Bad trumpet 'wah-wah': a plan fails, a flop, an anticlimax (like the sad trombone).

sounds.label: 歓声と拍手
sounds.name: 歓声と拍手 cheers
sounds.description: Crowd cheering and applause: a big win, a clutch play, a great performance or song.

sounds.label: 黄色い悲鳴
sounds.name: 黄色い悲鳴 fangirl scream
sounds.description: Excited 'kyaa!' screams: a teetee (wholesome) moment, a charming line, fans swooning.

sounds.label: 爆発1
sounds.name: 爆発 explosion
sounds.description: Explosion: she rages, something blows up in-game, a rage quit, or total chaos.

sounds.label: エアーホーン
sounds.name: エアーホーン air horn
sounds.description: Air horn: hype, a sick play, an over-the-top 'let's go' moment. Use sparingly.

sounds.label: DJのスクラッチ1
sounds.name: スクラッチ record scratch
sounds.description: Record scratch: 'wait, what?', a sudden stop, a freeze-frame before explaining how we got here.

sounds.label: 回想
sounds.name: 回想 flashback
sounds.description: Flashback shimmer: a callback to something earlier, 'remember when…'.

sounds.label: 文字表示の衝撃音1
sounds.name: 文字表示 impact
sounds.description: Trailer impact hit: a big caption or title card slams onto the screen.
